name: Home Assistant Statistics
description: Publishes privacy-conscious aggregate rename statistics as Home Assistant sensor entities.

settings.label: Home Assistant URL
settings.description: The local URL of your Home Assistant instance.

settings.label: Long-lived access token
settings.description: Create a long-lived access token in your Home Assistant profile. It is encrypted by the operating system and is never exposed to the extension.

capabilities.reason: Publish aggregate counters and recent/top media names directly to the configured Home Assistant instance. File paths and credentials are never included.
